about_the_game:
Additional 10 levels of Dead Man's Marathon Battle Pass will help you unlock many rewards:
  • Unique sawed-off shotgun;
  • Exclusive Japanese blade;
  • Themed camouflage for weapons and armor;
  • Tools and components to improve your gear;
  • Additional Premium days and more.

Note!
  • This seasonal Battle Pass can only be activated once per character;
  • All rewards are personal;
  • All rewards can be found on your Personal Warehouse;
  • If at the time of purchase you have already activated a Battle Pass in the game, then its cost will be refunded to you in Stalcoins by letter to the in-game mail;
  • These rewards are not cross-platform and can only be used on Steam;
  • These rewards can only be granted to the same Steam account that was used to made the purchase. If you have some issues, contact our EXBO Support;
  • EXBO may update, replace, or remove in-game content at any time.
